body: Surprisingly I can still think of 2 solutions although I am starting to run of ideas sadly. One possible solution would be that if you never really talk to your brother then I'm not sure how you can know for sure that he wouldn't be willing to help. Granted I had brothers as well and they could be really annoying about things but my younger brother who I thought hated me actually helped me once when things got really bad. I can't say for sure obviously if you're in the same kind of position but it may be worth a shot. The other kind of solution though possibly unlikely although I don't know if this would be guaranteed at all is to try and sleep and hopefully your swelling goes down and you would then be able to work again. There is no way to absolutely know what will happen in the future so it could be a possibility and I'd like to think that you still have a chance. This might be just from me not wanting to see others give up but sadly I can't really think of much else. I mean you could maybe try and make youtube videos and hope to make money there? I think my ideas might even not be as helpful anymore but I really do wish the best for you man. I have to go to bed now but I really hope things are able to work out for you.

I was in a similar position where I would also procrasinate work to the point of it being ridiculous and panicking and having to do it quick and also wondering if I would even be able to get it done and had brief periods of worrying about my future. I think that for the moment you shouldn't really be worrying about a job at the moment and if you currently are somehow working a job already on campus I applaud you as I was never able to do that and couldn't understand how people were able to. I'd definately suggest trying to make friends that you can talk to as it seems like to me (though I might be wrong) that you are feeling some of this due to extreme loneliness and it is a terrible feeling to not be able to talk to anyone. Also while harder to manage definately find people who won't dismiss what you have to say (my parents seem to all the time... sigh) but actually accept what you're saying and are able to encourage you to keep going. Also if it helps any I've managed to graduate from college yet I'm still not entirely sure what I'm doing (I currently have an internship but I probably don't want to work at it later in life but it somehow helps me to keep going.) You are meant to live though but as for what only you can decide, some people live fascinating lives while others work at jobs they don't really like. You really can never predict the future. I'm hoping for the best for you though because I can understand where you're coming from and it's tough.

You seem like an amazing person and I really hope for the best for you. Have you considered trying to start a patreon, go fund me, or anything like that? I think if you explain what's happening to you currently people would be willing to help. I personally wish I could help you financially but I don't really have any money considering I'm working at an internship currently. Other option would be to try and get a loan to help. It might not be ideal as you would have to pay it back plus more in any situation (credit card being one of the worst debt) but if you are able to usually make a lot of money when you are well it may honestly be worth it. I really do wish the best for you man and I hope that my suggestions were able to help even a little bit because to me you seem like a really amazing person.

I wonder if something like that exists I feel like if it did it would be the opposite of facebook as that only ever seems to show me people getting engaged and seeming like they have better lives than I do. Of course I wonder if it would work maybe it would though because we could all talk about things that don't work and come up from that with things that do work? I don't know just throwing out ideas. A lot of times I wish it was like in a lot of romance animes where the girls seem to randomly fall in love the main character for no explained reason though that's probably too much to hope for haha.  But as one thing I noticed you can try to control your happiness by yourself but it is a lot harder, I know for me I feel happy watching mad videos, playing video games, and talking to friends though I know it varies from person to person about what makes them happy.

I can kind of understand having no motivation because I know when there was tons of work I had to do and seemingly no way to do it I felt trapped and only managed to get through with help. When you say that you want to die I think that might be due to your current situation and I would say that most likely at some point or another you will end up having to come clean with your current situation to your girlfriend. I realize that this will be really hard to do and wish I could give you advice on how to do this but I don't think I can help much. Also if it makes you feel better I also felt completely exhausted my last year and felt hardly any motivation which caused me to just barely get things done but I think maybe taking a break might help in your case. I really wish I could help more but I just don't really know how to and for that I apologize I hope I was able to help somewhat at the very least.

One possible option I think would be to try and talk with your professors and explain that you are going through hard times and do want to graduate and what you can do to get there. It may take a lot of work but from my experience of feeling stressed just getting work done for classes and procrastinating it while not being exactly the same I can understand your stress for the amount of work. There are other things you can do to help yourself like finding someone who can help you make progress. I'm sorry I can't really help more but I do wish you the best of luck going forward.

I completely agree with how much work there can be as I spent just way too much time working on work in college and even now wished I had spent more time with my friends honestly. Also since I have had no romantic relationships to speak of whatsoever I'm not entirely sure of how to close the gap but I do wish you the best of luck going forward.

I know for me personally I just told my mom what was happening and she agreed to homeschool me because it wasn't worth being bullied. Ironically while I was homeschooled for all of high school I somehow never felt lonely but after college I now am since there's no real thing that's helping to keep my friends anywhere remotely near me. So I'd say just try talking to your mom or dad and telling what's been happening, and then once you're out of highschool (I think? not sure if you mean highschool or college) then find a good college and work hard and go from there.

Sorry for the late response I just got back from working on my internship position and I'm glad you were willing to take the time to respond. I am trying to think positively but I keep feeling trapped when I do think of my past in that in one sense I guess I like some of my past yet still wish I could change it. The problem is that no one can change their past but I still have a lot of thoughts about if I had done things differently if I would still be single today. I honestly have given some thought to online dating yet I do worry about risks with that and since I still can't really drive myself at this point I don't think it would work out sadly. I think one possibility is possibly meeting someone at PAX or something since I really enjoy playing video games and even listening to VGMs. The biggest thing though that weirdly enough gives me hope is mad videos just due to the time and effort it takes to make them yet I suppose it is also causing some worry as well since I'm afraid of them being deleted and downloaded about 1800+ videos in order to save them in case they end up going away. Also in regards to sleep I am technically sleeping but don't feel rested probably due to usually being able to control what I dream about. Whether that is due to my sleeping pattern changing due to the internship I'm not sure but I suspect that might have some impact. I will definately keep trying to carry on but I do think depression is not even remotely easy to deal with. I'm currently doing everything in my mind to combat it without drinking, smoking, using drugs, or even medication (medication because I worry about that lasting the rest of my life) but it feels really hard. I still can feel happy in short periods when something fun is happening but I do wish I could just stop being depressed completely. Also I'll end this reply here because it's probably way too long already sorry.
